name: Bruce Lunsford
summary: William Bruce Lunsford (November 11, 1947 – September 5, 2026) was an American attorney, businessman and politician from Kentucky. He served various roles in the Kentucky Democratic Party, including party treasurer, Deputy Development Secretary, and Head of Commerce. Lunsford was the Democratic nominee for Kentucky's United States Senate seat in 2008, unsuccessfully challenging incumbent Mitch McConnell.
